Dear Adatum Ltd,

We have processed your refund of 80 for the conversion loss resulting from the incorrect invoice currency on your recent invoice.

The refund has been issued and your account has been updated accordingly. Please allow a few business days for the funds to reflect in your account.

If you have any further questions, please don't hesitate to reach out.

Best regards,
Customer Support
